description: Experimental Schema v1.1-candidate for PROMPT-SCHEMA-V2 regeneration. NOT production-canonical. Changes vs v1.0: nullable translations (except arabic), nullable mnemonic, min/max bounds on relation arrays, difficulty_score decoupled from numeric-string enum to avoid Vertex proto collision (see v1.1 note). Semantic rules (exactly-one-primary, sequential sense_no, exact-token examples) remain validator-enforced, not schema-enforced.

id.description: Unique input ID. Preserve exactly as received.

lemma.description: Exact supplied target lemma. Preserve spelling and casing.

pos.description: Grammatical part of speech. Supplied POS is authoritative.

difficulty_score.description: Learner-difficulty estimate 1-10, stored as string for legacy DB TEXT contract. 1=concrete/basic, 10=abstract/nuanced. Range is validator-enforced; no enum to avoid Gemini proto collision with numeric-string members.

ai_confidence.description: MODEL SELF-CONFIDENCE only. Not a probability, not calibrated, not evidence. Lower when important uncertainty exists.

phonetic_us.description: American English IPA. NO slashes or brackets.

phonetic_uk.description: British English IPA, NO slashes. Null = effectively identical to US; never invent a distinction.

phonetic_ar.description: English pronunciation transliterated to Arabic script with selective vocalization where it improves pronunciation.

definition_en.description: Clear, simple English definition, max 20 words, high-frequency vocabulary, no target lemma, no circularity.

explanation_ar.description: Natural Arabic explanation, Modern Standard Arabic, written as a teacher, meaning-preserving not word-for-word.

examples.description: Exactly 3 natural examples, each containing the exact target lemma as a standalone token.

example_text.description: Natural sentence containing the exact target lemma as a standalone token.

mnemonic_ar.description: Optional retrieval hook in simple Arabic, no tashkeel, no parentheses/brackets, English words in double quotes. Default null unless it passes BOTH Counterfactual and Novelty tests. Never a translation/paraphrase/definition echo.

senses.description: Distinct genuine learner senses. Fewer accurate senses than many redundant ones. Exactly-one-primary and sequential sense_no are validator-enforced, not schema-enforced.

definition_en.description: Simple explanation, max 20 words, no target lemma.

short_def_en.description: Core gloss, 2-6 words, not a truncation of definition_en.

is_primary.description: Exactly one true per entry; validator-enforced.

semantic_tags.description: 3-5 useful topical tags. No decorative or redundant tags.

usage_note.description: Short learner-relevant distinction only when useful. Empty string otherwise.

mnemonic_ar.description: Usually null on secondary senses unless independently strong. Rules as entry-level mnemonic_ar.

collocations.description: 3-5 natural established pairings preferred; do not manufacture to fill quota.

synonyms.description: Up to 5 genuine semantic alternatives. Avoid loose thematic associations.

antonyms.description: Up to 3 clear antonyms. Empty array if none.

related_words.description: Semantic associations, NOT a word family.

ar.description: Direct Arabic translations of the related English words.

word_family.description: Genuine morphological relatives only. Inflections, arbitrary related words, and spelling variants are excluded.

noun.description: Noun form, empty string if none.

verb.description: Verb form, empty string if none.

adj.description: Adjective form, empty string if none.

adv.description: Adverb form, empty string if none.

translations.description: Multilingual translations. arabic_ar required and natural/context-appropriate. Other languages nullable: null is a valid decision when confidence is insufficient. Null is a sign of accuracy, not failure.

arabic_ar.description: Primary Arabic translation; separate distinct meanings with ' / '.

chinese_zh.description: Simplified Chinese + Pinyin, e.g. 你好 (Nǐ hǎo).
